links.outcome: Correct triage urgency of ophthalmic vignettes by chatbots versus trainees
links.effect: Triage urgency appropriate in 38 (86%) trainees, 43 (98%) ChatGPT, 37 (84%) Bing Chat; Bing tended to overestimate urgency.
links.quote: Triage urgency was appropriate in 38 (86%), 43 (98%), and 37 (84%) cases for ophthalmology trainees, ChatGPT, and Bing Chat, correspondingly.

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of chatbots compared with ophthalmology trainees on the same vignettes
links.effect: Correct diagnosis in top 3: trainees 42 (95%), ChatGPT 41 (93%), Bing Chat 34 (77%), WebMD 8 (33%).
links.quote: The ophthalmologists in training, ChatGPT, Bing Chat, and the WebMD Symptom Checker listed the appropriate diagnosis among the top 3 suggestions in 42 (95%), 41 (93%), 34 (77%), and 8 (33%) cases, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial generative LLM chatbots (GPT-4, Bing Chat) on diagnostic and triage accuracy using simulated ophthalmic clinical vignettes.
